description: The `oracles` dev extra installs music21, the LilyPond wheel and xmlschema
The MusicXML 3.1 XSD is vendored with its licence and used offline
`make oracle-check` runs the oracle tests and skips loudly without the extra
A CI job installs the extra and runs `make oracle-check`
(oracle) Every fixture's notated export validates against the MusicXML 3.1 XSD
Meter beats and unit come from the spec; bar length from the spec, not a CLI flag; per-part polymeter as per-part time signatures or a lossy code
`key_map` changes appear as `<key>` at the measure of change
`tempo_map` changes appear as `<direction>`/`<sound tempo>` at their measures (dense rubato maps thinned to a documented resolution)
`pickup:` exports as an anacrusis (implicit measure) and downbeats align
`dynamic` marks export as `<dynamics>`
`art` and slur groups export as `<articulations>` and `<slur>`; unrepresentable ones carry `lossy_articulation` for MusicXML too
`holds` export as `<fermata>`; form sections as `<rehearsal>` marks
The exact-tick exporter (`export_musicxml`) emits one part per layer and `<chord/>` for simultaneous onsets

(oracle) music21 structural parity per fixture: parts = pitched layers, measures = ceil(duration / bar), time signatures = meter(s), key signatures = key_map, pitch multiset per part = spec, total quarterLength per part = spec sum within quantization
Lossy diagnostics enumerate exactly the constructs each export dropped, and the INTEROP.md matrix is generated from the same registry
One layer per `<part>`, named from `part-name`
`<chord/>`, `<backup>`, `<forward>`, `<voice>` produce simultaneous onsets and voice-aware cursors
`divisions`, `<time>`, `<key>`, `<sound tempo>` changes are honoured per measure; ties merge into one event
(oracle) Corpus round trip: music21 corpus piece → our import: duration within 1 %, notes per part equal, spec validates and renders
Self round trip: notated export → import → same parts, onsets and pitch multisets (quantization documented)
Multi-track MIDI import keeps parts and timing
(oracle) MIDI export writes one track per layer and every note survives
MIDI export carries the tempo map as tempo events
`tuning: edo divisions=19` drives the render
Without a tuning directive, renders are byte-identical to today
Until NTUN-001 passes, a non-12-EDO tuning compiles with a registered `tuning_not_rendered` diagnostic (the row becomes N/A once NTUN-001 passes)
Microtonal pitches export as MIDI pitch bend and MusicXML decimal `<alter>`; unrepresentable cases carry a code
(oracle) Chord roots agree with music21 for non-symmetric qualities
Symmetric and relative collections are declared ambiguous with candidates, and the documented set matches exactly
Analysis reports state their scope; no key-finding, roman-numeral or realism claim is made
Pitch-class-set theory (AF-M01) is reachable through `analyze` (normal form, prime form, IC vector, set class)
The music21-bridge decision (D3) is recorded
(oracle) Every fixture's notated export engraves through `musicxml2ly` + `lilypond` with zero warnings
`audioforge score --engrave` uses the LilyPond backend when the extra is installed and gives a structured hint otherwise
The matplotlib PDF is named a proportional proof sheet everywhere; the word "engrave" is reserved for LilyPond
The proof sheet renders dynamics text without missing-glyph warnings
`docs/INTEROP.md` carries a generated coverage matrix (construct × format → preserved / quantized / lossy code / unsupported) with a `--check` twin
The capability manifest lists notation directives (`tuning`, `tuplet`, `lyrics`) with rendering status and the interop coverage
README has a "Notation and analysis" section stating scope and delegation
`DSL_GAP_SPEC.md` G6/G8 state the measured limits (inert tuning, flattened import) with harness IDs instead of "closed"
ADR-0011 records the positioning: semantic score contract, oracle-verified interchange, engraving and musicology delegated, proof sheet retained
A committed fixture corpus with expected-features JSON exists (≥ 8 specs)
The surface's existing tests keep passing
`make check` green and coverage ≥ 90.1 % with the new code
Goldens unchanged by notation work
The runner exists and evidence bundles are tracked
The plan is registered in `docs/backlog.yml`
Notated MusicXML export ≤ 1 s and MIDI export ≤ 0.5 s for a 3 000-note spec
(oracle) `musicxml2ly` + `lilypond` ≤ 30 s for 116 measures
Proof-sheet PDF ≤ 15 s for 116 measures
MusicXML import ≤ 1 s for a four-part ten-measure chorale
Every `score_layer` property (meter, pickup, form, repeat, polymeter) has a defined projection or a registered lossy code in both exporters
`notation.tuplets` and `notation.lyrics` project to `<time-modification>` and `<lyric>`, or carry a code
